item.title: Monetary Policy Committee Maintains Repo Rate at 6.50 Percent
item.description: The Monetary Policy Committee decided to keep the policy repo rate unchanged at 6.50% to align inflation with the 4% target.

item.title: RBI Issues Revised Regulatory Guidelines for Commercial Banks on Lending Standards
item.description: Reserve Bank of India releases updated prudential framework applicable to commercial lenders including HDFC Bank and State Bank of India.
